overview: One item: a striker that ties two obsidian frames to each other instead of to the map, so a portal comes out where you built it.

1.1.2: Mod Menu's Donate button leads to sponsoring the author on GitHub. Nothing in play changes.
1.1.1: Works with Pandorical as old as 15.13.0. Before 15.24.1 a struck portal does not show where it leads.
1.1.0: With Pandorical's immersive portals on, a struck portal shows the far end of its link through the swirl.
Between frames facing different ways, looking straight through always comes out of the same face: the one the portal shows. It used to come down to how slightly you were turned.
1.0.1: Release notes rewritten to read plainly; nothing in play changes.
1.0.0: Strike one frame, walk to another, strike that, and the two lead to each other.
Struck portals stay out of vanilla's search for somewhere to arrive.
An ordinary pair now goes back the way it came.
